author: Adrian Collins
description:
Baldur’s Gate 3: Astarion by T. Kingfisher is the first tie-in novel to Larian Studio’s record-breaking, award-winning video game, Baldur’s Gate 3. Adventurous and funny with real darkness at its heart, you don’t need to be familiar with the game—or even the world of Dungeons & Dragons—to enjoy this fast, pacey and delightfully chaotic romp […]
